Candidate only. Four M3x16 screws retain the original mounting-foot interface. Two pads at Z69 support the verified auxiliary shoulder. The stepped rear cover and auxiliary stub remain free. Connect both downward-facing bus plugs before fastening the module; route wires through the matching cover window X=-19.35 to -9.65, Y=-12.7 to 12.7. Side-loaded M3 nuts retain the 2.9 mm roof and original M3x10 cap stack.

Candidate only. Two 2.5 mm lips contact the verified main-face shoulder near X=0, Y=+/-11. The raised tail cover is open above. Four M3x10 screws retain 0.3 mm ear-closing travel and 0.45 mm lateral adjustment. Stop when the case is retained without distortion; verify the actual C018 shoulder before production.

Seat directly on the metal horn outer face. Four M3x6 screws with 0.5 mm washers of at most 6.0 mm outer diameter sit in the 1.5 mm deep counterbores and engage 2.0 mm of the 2.5 mm metal flange. Verify this stack with the real horn. Fit the spline retaining screw before the cradle. Four M3 nuts enter the bottom pockets for the cradle feet.

Print on the column rear faces at X=-8.5, with removable build-plate support beneath the central rear plate at X=-4.5. The USB spine retains 6 mm of material and rounded port transitions. Fit the outer post nuts through the 7.4 mm rear access wells, at the unchanged M3x16 stack plane. Fit four nuts from the phone side for the unchanged rear feet. Both camera ends and long-edge button relief remain open. Measure actual buttons, cameras and the parked charging plug before assembly.

Insert the landscape bare phone from above, then attach this cap with two M3x16 screws. The corner-seat top gap is 0.5 mm. The central long edge has button relief; front retention covers the outer corner regions, with both rear ends open for the camera.

One M3x16 screw attaches this short corner clip at the unchanged lower post hole. The two clips retain the lower corners independently. The landscape bare phone has 0.5 mm end clearance and 0.55 mm screen clearance; do not tighten against the glass.

Print on a broad Y side. Fit two M3x10 screws downward through the foot into hub nuts, then two M3x10 screws from behind into the frame nuts. Check tips remain behind the phone cavity.
